d: Israel has voted, but it still doesn't have a government. Neither Benjamin Netanyahu nor his rivals have secured the numbers needed to form a coalition. The biggest surprise? Israel’s Arab parties have won 19 seats, making them potential kingmakers. The opposition could cross the majority mark with their support - but some of its own allies refuse to work with them. Can Netanyahu hold on to power? Or will Israel finally get a new government? Palki Sharma tells you.
